hero.title: NiceChunk contracts, live game configuration, and PDA transparency.
hero.subtitle: This page now separates the game client's real runtime configuration from contracts that exist in code but are still gated. Players can inspect source code, PDA structures, and public devnet accounts from one page.
hero.networkNote: The current game runtime points to Solana devnet through mainnet.json. Mainnet finality and live civilization governance are not claimed here.

directory.title: Current NiceChunk programs and runtime status.
directory.body: The table lists repository contracts, their program IDs, and whether they are part of the current game runtime or still gated.

flow.title: Wie der aktuelle Gameplay-Pfad die Chain beruehrt.

steps.title: Genesis-Konfiguration lesen
steps.body: The client derives GlobalConfig from the core program and reads world seed, chunk size, build limits, NCK mint, and published config hashes.
steps.writes: No user write; derives GlobalConfig PDA
steps.audit: GlobalConfig magic, world seed, hash fields, and runtime program IDs

steps.title: Spielerprofil erstellen
steps.body: The player program stores wallet-owned profile data, default attributes, position, equipment slots, and backpack style.
steps.audit: Owner wallet, profile name, position, equipped backpack, and update slot

steps.title: Mining-Session offnen
steps.body: A player can create a short-lived session authority so repeated mining actions do not require wallet confirmation every block.
steps.writes: PlayerSession PDA with authority, expiry, and action budget
steps.audit: Allowed action bitmask, maxActions, usedActions, expiresAt

steps.title: Zerlegte Blocks speichern
steps.body: The chunk program verifies the generated single block, then writes a compact 3-byte broken-block record into the chunk-broken PDA.
steps.writes: ChunkBrokenState record under the Chunk program
steps.audit: Packed broken-block records, minY, count/capacity, and block proof assumptions

steps.title: Ressourcen anhaengen
steps.body: The backpack program is prepared to append mined resource records after session validation. It is the inventory-side bridge for the mining loop.
steps.audit: Foundation footprint, revision state, shard bitmap, NCM3 hash, and Guardian blueprint hash

steps.title: Smelt Resources Into Items
steps.body: The smelting program reads a recipe table PDA, validates selected backpack input and fuel slots, removes those slots through the backpack program, and appends material or item outputs back into the same backpack through the smelting authority PDA.
steps.writes: Backpack slot append or mutation through authorized program signer
steps.audit: Backpack owner, itemCount, slot payload, durability, material/item identity

steps.title: List Backpack Items
steps.body: The marketplace reads the selected 80-byte slot from the seller Backpack PDA, removes that slot, and escrows the full slot snapshot inside the Listing PDA.
steps.writes: RecipeTable read plus Backpack remove/append through smelting authority
steps.audit: Recipe IDs, heat tiers, input/output volumes, disabled recipes, output slot evidence

steps.title: Settle Market Orders
steps.body: A buyer pays in NCK or SOL, the program routes a 1% market fee to treasury, and the escrowed backpack slot is delivered to the buyer through the market authority.
steps.audit: Seller, buyer, currency, price, escrow state, and original slot snapshot

steps.title: Publish Player Buildings
steps.body: The building program validates player sessions, indexes foundation chunks, stages NCM3 payload shards, finalizes a hashed manifest, and can publish Guardian blueprint summaries.
steps.writes: Listing settlement and buyer Backpack delivery
steps.audit: Treasury fee routing, payment mint/native flag, settled slot, and final listing state

developer.title: Referenzen fuer Frontend und Scripts.
developer.boundaryBody: This page documents the current devnet-facing contract surface and the game runtime configuration loaded from mainnet.json. It does not claim final mainnet governance, live civilization execution, land ownership, complete realtime decentralization, or complete gameplay decentralization.
developer.pdaCode:
GlobalConfig: ["global-config"]
PlayerProfile: ["player-v7", owner]
PlayerSession: ["session", owner, sessionAuthority]
ChunkBrokenState: ["chunk-broken", globalConfig, chunkX:i32_le, chunkZ:i32_le]
ResourceDropTable: ["resource-drop-table", globalConfig, tableId:u64_le]
Backpack: ["backpack", creator, backpackId:u64_le]
RecipeTable: ["smelting-recipes", tableId:u64_le]
MarketplaceListing: ["listing", seller, listingId:u64_le]
RuleBook: ["rule-book", ruleIdHash]
RuleSignature: ["rule-signature", ruleBook, signer]
RuleTally: ["rule-tally", ruleBook]
ExecutionReceipt: ["rule-execution", ruleBook]
PowerSnapshot: ["power-snapshot", snapshotHash]
CitizenPower: ["citizen-power", powerSnapshot, citizen]
BuildSite: ["build-site-v1", globalConfig, foundationId:u64_le]
BuildingManifest: ["building-v2", globalConfig, foundationId:u64_le, revision:u32_le]
BuildingShard: ["building-data-v1", globalConfig, foundationId:u64_le, revision:u32_le, shardIndex:u8]
GuardianBlueprintAuthority: ["guardian-blueprint", globalConfig]

programs.name: NiceChunk Genesis Core
programs.role: Immutable world configuration and NCK mint validation.
programs.summary: The core program initializes the GlobalConfig PDA once. It writes compiled genesis parameters such as world seed, world ID, config hashes, NCK mint, NCK decimals, genesis supply, fees, chunk limits, and guardian parameters. It does not mint items, manage inventory, update admin settings, or run gameplay logic.
instructions: Validates SPL Token mint layout, decimals, initialized flag, genesis supply, disabled mint authority, and disabled freeze authority.
Creates or allocates the GlobalConfig PDA safely even if the PDA was pre-funded with dust lamports.
storage: World ID and 32-byte world seed.
Terrain, resource rule, and client world config hashes.
NCK mint, decimals, genesis supply, and development wallet.
Chunk size, section height, build limits, max terrain height, sea level, cooldowns, and guardian settings.
notes: This is the immutable genesis config layer for the current devnet build.
Future crafting, inventory, chunk state, world knowledge, and reputation systems belong in separate programs or future modules after PDA specs are finalized.
Devnet and testnet must use their own NCK mint; the mainnet mint should not be reused on development clusters.

pdaAccounts.name: GlobalConfig
pdaAccounts.purpose: Immutable genesis configuration for the current world.

programs.name: NiceChunk Player
programs.role: Wallet-owned player profile, position, equipment slots, backpack style, and mining session authority.
programs.summary: The player program creates a wallet-bound profile and a short-lived session authority. The session lets the game submit repeated allowed actions, such as block breaking, without opening the wallet for every single mined block.
storage: Owner wallet, GlobalConfig address, world ID, bump, and timestamps.
Base attributes: health, energy, stamina, mining power, build power, and defense.
Current position and nine equipment slots.
Session authority, allowed action bitmask, expiration time, max actions, and action count.
notes: The profile is public state. It stores the equipped backpack public key, while private backpack contents are loaded separately when the player opens inventory flows.
The current session model is used to reduce repeated wallet prompts during mining.
Sessions are bounded by expiration, allowed action flags, and max action count.

pdaAccounts.name: PlayerProfile
pdaAccounts.purpose: Wallet-owned public player state and equipped backpack pointer.
fields: base health, energy, stamina and power fields

pdaAccounts.name: PlayerSession
pdaAccounts.purpose: Short-lived gameplay authority for repeated allowed actions.

programs.name: NiceChunk Chunk
programs.role: Verifies generated single blocks and records compact broken-block state per chunk.
programs.accountSize: ChunkState: 8,280 bytes; ChunkBrokenState: 16-byte header + 3 bytes per record
programs.summary: The chunk program uses the current optimized mining path. For mining, the player submits one world block coordinate. The program derives the chunk, verifies the generated block, rejects air/water/bedrock or already-mined positions, and appends a compressed broken-block record.
storage: Legacy ChunkState stores up to 128 64-byte block deltas.
ChunkBrokenState stores a 16-byte header and 3-byte mined-block records.
A record packs local x, local z, and y offset. Capacity starts at 64, grows by 64, and caps at 2,048 records.
GlobalConfig world seed, chunk size, build height, max terrain height, and sea level are used for generated block verification.
notes: This is the current mining write path used by the browser client.
MagicBlock delegation hooks exist in the codebase, but the current gameplay path does not require MagicBlock.
Backpack resource settlement is intentionally separate so mining state and inventory state can evolve independently.

pdaAccounts.name: ChunkBrokenState
pdaAccounts.purpose: Sparse record of generated blocks broken by players.
fields: grows by capacity instead of storing full terrain

pdaAccounts.name: ResourceDropTable
pdaAccounts.purpose: Bounded extra-drop rules for rewarded mining.
fields: salt plus min/max drop volume in mm³

programs.name: NiceChunk Building
programs.kind: Build sites, NCM3 building manifests, and Guardian blueprint publishing
programs.role: Owns BuildSite v2 accounts, chunk indexing, building manifests, upload shards, resize flow, and Guardian blueprint publishing authority.
programs.accountSize: BuildSite: 160 bytes; legacy BuildSite: 136 bytes; BuildingManifest: 160 bytes; BuildingShard: 64 + payload bytes
programs.summary: The Building program is the active devnet surface for player-owned foundations and NCM3 building payloads. It validates player sessions, creates and resizes BuildSite accounts, registers occupied chunks through the chunk authority PDA, stages building uploads in shards, finalizes manifests after hash and fit checks, supports legacy BuildSite migration, and publishes Guardian blueprint updates through a program-derived authority.
storage: BuildSite stores owner, global config, foundation ID, footprint, surface Y, active and pending revisions, indexed chunk counters, staged resize dimensions, and update slots.
BuildingManifest stores owner, global config, foundation ID, revision, payload length, expected NCM3 hash, dimensions, rotation, offsets, shard count, uploaded bitmap, and status.
BuildingShard stores one bounded payload segment for an NCM3 building upload, with uploaded length and payload bytes after the 64-byte header.
notes: Build actions require a valid PlayerSession and matching PlayerProfile before state changes are accepted.
A BuildingManifest only becomes active after all shards are written, the payload hash matches, and the NCM3 dimensions fit the BuildSite footprint and world height limits.
Guardian blueprint publication is restricted to the treasury or configured blueprint publisher wallet and calls the Guardian program through the Building program PDA.
The 136-byte legacy BuildSite layout is still decoded so deployed foundations can be migrated safely.

pdaAccounts.name: BuildSite
pdaAccounts.purpose: Player-owned foundation footprint and revision state for a build site.

pdaAccounts.name: BuildingManifest
pdaAccounts.purpose: Upload and activation manifest for one NCM3 building revision.

pdaAccounts.name: BuildingShard
pdaAccounts.size: 64-byte header plus payload, up to 8,256 bytes
pdaAccounts.purpose: Bounded shard payload used to upload an NCM3 building before finalization.

pdaAccounts.name: GuardianBlueprintAuthority
pdaAccounts.purpose: Program signer for publishing verified building blueprint summaries into Guardian regions.
fields: Calls Guardian update_blueprint with the expected region and global config

programs.name: NiceChunk Guardian Registry
programs.role: Registers NCK-staked Guardian regions with operator-only endpoints, liveness proof, blueprint metadata, and governance recovery.
programs.summary: The guardian program records public service endpoints for regional realtime infrastructure. A guardian registers a region, pays the NCK registration amount to the treasury token account, and periodically submits proofs. The registry is non-custodial and does not sign player transactions.
storage: Registry stores GlobalConfig, NCK mint, treasury token account, active count, and genesis flag.
Region stores treasury ownership, the Guardian operator, endpoint, stake/proof state, and chain-committed blueprint hash, revision, and record count.
Region size is 100 by 100 chunks. Registration requires a 100,000 NCK treasury payment at 6 decimals.
Proof interval is 3,600 seconds. Settlement can slash 10% per missed proof window until removal.
notes: The current web Guardian page reads this registry and region PDA data from devnet.
Only the stored Guardian operator can update the endpoint. Governance can rotate the operator; governance or the restricted publisher can update blueprint metadata.
The registration payment goes to the treasury token account; this registry does not provide user-initiated unstaking or withdrawal.

pdaAccounts.name: GuardianRegistry
pdaAccounts.purpose: Global Guardian registry and treasury pointer.

pdaAccounts.name: GuardianRegion
pdaAccounts.purpose: Registered realtime region endpoint and stake state.

programs.name: NiceChunk Backpack
programs.kind: Inventory slot layer for blocks, resources, and items
programs.role: Creates player backpacks, stores block-resource and item slots, removes selected slots, and accepts marketplace or smelting-authorized delivery.
programs.summary: The backpack program is the inventory storage layer for mined block resources, smelted materials, forged items, and marketplace escrow. Version 3 stores fixed 80-byte slots that represent block resources, material items, and forged items with durability, grade, item level, quality, and metadata. Mining appends block-resource slots through validated player sessions, marketplace flows can remove and restore resources, and smelting can append item slots only through the smelting authority PDA.
instructions: requires a PlayerProfile with no equipped backpack
storage: Backpack header stores backpack ID, owner, capacity, item count, state, placement fields, timestamps, and flags.
Default capacity is 50 slots. Max capacity is 99 slots.
Each v3 BackpackSlotRecord is 80 bytes: kind, category, flags, quantity, resource coordinate, item code, item ID, item PDA, volume, durability, grade, item level, quality, and metadata.
Slot kind 1 stores block resources. Slot kind 2 stores item/material records such as smelted outputs or forged outputs.
The decoder only accepts the current v3 account layout.
notes: Backpack contents are separate from public player profile display; the player profile stores only the equipped backpack public key.
The marketplace program can escrow or deliver backpack resources through the market-authority PDA.
The smelting program can append material or item outputs through the smelting-authority PDA; users cannot mint arbitrary item slots directly.
Direct player appends remain restricted to validated mining sessions for block resources.

pdaAccounts.name: Backpack
pdaAccounts.purpose: Wallet-owned inventory PDA for block resources and item references.
fields: up to 99 slot records with block resource or item reference

programs.name: NiceChunk Smelting
programs.kind: Recipe table and backpack item creation layer
programs.role: Stores smelting recipe tables, consumes selected backpack resources and fuels, and appends material or item outputs back into the backpack.
programs.summary: The smelting program separates recipe authority from backpack storage. A recipe table PDA stores up to 12 recipes, each with up to 8 input slots and 4 output slots. Executing a recipe validates selected backpack inputs and fuel, removes those slots through the backpack program, then appends material or item outputs through the smelting authority PDA.
instructions: execute_smelting supports input indexes, fuel indexes, and a batch multiplier.
storage: RecipeTable stores table ID, authority, recipe count, timestamps, and fixed-size recipe records.
Each RecipeRecord stores recipe ID, enabled flag, minimum heat tier, input count, output count, up to 8 input BackpackSlot records, up to 4 output BackpackSlot records, and updated slot.
BackpackSlot records support block resources and item/material outputs.
Recipe table authority can upsert recipes or transfer authority.
notes: The recipe table is intentionally independent so civilization or governance systems can add and update recipes later.
Execution validates backpack ownership, recipe matching, input slots, fuel slots, and batch multiplier before consuming inventory.
Outputs are appended through the backpack program using the smelting authority PDA; users cannot mint arbitrary smelting outputs directly.

pdaAccounts.name: RecipeTable
pdaAccounts.purpose: Authority-owned smelting recipe table used by the smelting program.
fields: each recipe stores heat tier, input slots, output slots and updatedSlot

pdaAccounts.name: SmeltingAuthority
pdaAccounts.purpose: Program signer used to append outputs back into a backpack after recipe validation.

programs.name: NiceChunk Marketplace
programs.role: Creates listings from seller Backpack PDA slots, escrows the full 80-byte slot, settles NCK or SOL payment, and restores or delivers inventory on cancel or purchase.
programs.summary: The marketplace program is the current devnet trading surface for backpack inventory. A seller can only list an existing slot from their Backpack PDA; the contract reads that slot, removes it, and stores the full 80-byte slot snapshot in the Listing PDA. Cancellation restores the slot to the seller, purchase delivers it to the buyer, and user payload no longer supplies category, quantity, durability, grade, item level, quality, or item hash.
instructions: Create listing only accepts listingId, currency, sourceIndex, and price; item parameters are read from the Backpack PDA.
Cancellation and purchase write the Listing-owned 80-byte slot back into the target Backpack through the market-authority PDA.
Payment supports NCK and SOL with a 1% market fee.
storage: Listing stores seller wallet, listing ID, currency, source backpack index, price, the full source slot snapshot, timestamps, buyer, and final settlement fields.
The source slot is copied from Backpack v3 slot data during create_listing; category, quantity, itemCode, durability, grade, itemLevel, and quality are never accepted from user payload.
Listing state is active, canceled, or sold.
notes: Only the listing seller can cancel an active listing.
Buyers cannot purchase their own listings.
Only the marketplace PDA can restore or deliver escrowed slots through the backpack program.
Treasury fee is 1% of the listing price in the chosen currency.

pdaAccounts.name: MarketplaceListing
pdaAccounts.purpose: Seller-owned escrow and settlement state for a backpack slot.

pdaAccounts.name: MarketplaceAuthority
pdaAccounts.purpose: Program signer for escrow restore, delivery, and settlement authority boundaries.
fields: Does not custody player wallets outside explicit instructions

programs.name: NiceChunk Civilization
programs.role: Publishes rulebooks, signatures, tallies, execution receipts, Civilization Value snapshots, and citizen power accounts.
programs.magic: NCKCVR01 / NCKCVS01 / NCKCVT01 / NCKCVE01 / NCKCVP01 / NCKCVC01
programs.accountSize: RuleBook: 320; Signature: 136; Tally: 128; Receipt: 128; PowerSnapshot: 128; CitizenPower: 144 bytes
programs.summary: The Civilization program exists in the repository and SDK, but it is not part of the current mainnet.json game runtime configuration yet. It is the gated rule layer for publishing rule proposals, signing them with settled contribution power, tallying signatures, recording execution, and making Civilization Value auditable through PDA accounts.
storage: RuleBook stores hashes, target program/PDA, threshold, risk level, total power, required power, and tally counters.
RuleSignature stores signer side and settled snapshot power.
PowerSnapshot stores authority-signed total active power, window epochs, hash, and expiry.
CitizenPower stores a citizen power amount bound to one snapshot and expiry window.
notes: Player chain submission is intentionally gated until program deployment and devnet e2e proof are complete.
Civilization Value cannot be self-reported; power snapshots and citizen power settlement require the configured authority signer.
This contract is shown so players can inspect the intended PDA structure before live governance is enabled.

pdaAccounts.name: RuleBook
pdaAccounts.purpose: Published civilization rule proposal bound to target program and target PDA.

pdaAccounts.name: RuleSignature
pdaAccounts.purpose: One signer side and settled contribution power for a rulebook.

pdaAccounts.name: RuleTally
pdaAccounts.purpose: Final tally record for a rulebook.

pdaAccounts.name: ExecutionReceipt
pdaAccounts.purpose: Receipt that a finalized rule was executed or acknowledged.

pdaAccounts.name: PowerSnapshot
pdaAccounts.purpose: Authority-signed Civilization Value window snapshot.

pdaAccounts.name: CitizenPower
pdaAccounts.purpose: A citizen contribution power amount inside one snapshot window.

chainBrowser.body: Scan NiceChunk program accounts, decode known PDA layouts, and inspect players, build sites, buildings, backpacks, smelting tables, market listings, Guardian regions, and chunk deltas without trusting a private database.

chainBrowser.empty: No decoded accounts found for this group.

all.title: All known PDA groups
all.body: Scans each decoded NiceChunk account family exposed by this page. This is a public RPC read, not a backend export.
all.visible: Program owner, PDA address, decoded header fields, and safe samples from bounded account data.
all.trust: Lets players compare the website, source code, PDA layout, and live devnet state from one screen.

global-config.title: GlobalConfig
global-config.body: The immutable genesis configuration for this devnet world.
global-config.visible: NCK mint, world ID, world seed hash material, config hashes, chunk limits, and guardian parameters.
global-config.trust: Shows the world is not secretly changing seed, resource config, or core limits from a private server.

player-profile.title: PlayerProfile
player-profile.visible: Owner wallet, position, attributes, equipment summary, equipped backpack pointer, and update slots.
player-profile.trust: Players can see which identities exist and which backpack each public profile points to.

player-session.title: PlayerSession
player-session.body: Short-lived authority used to reduce repeated wallet prompts during allowed gameplay actions.
player-session.visible: Owner, session authority, allowed action flags, expiration, max actions, and used action count.
player-session.trust: Shows that session power is bounded instead of an unlimited hidden operator key.

chunk-broken.title: ChunkBrokenState
chunk-broken.body: Compact per-chunk mining record for blocks that players have already broken.
chunk-broken.visible: Version, capacity, minY, count, and sample packed broken-block records.
chunk-broken.trust: Makes mined terrain changes auditable without storing full terrain on-chain.

resource-drop-table.title: ResourceDropTable
resource-drop-table.body: Bounded v2 resource drop rule table used by mining rewards.
resource-drop-table.visible: Source block, drop block, base chance basis points, altitude/depth bounds, salt, and drop volume range.
resource-drop-table.trust: Lets players inspect drop rules instead of trusting opaque reward logic.

guardian-registry.title: GuardianRegistry
guardian-registry.body: Global registry for realtime service coverage.
guardian-registry.visible: Treasury token, active count, registrations, stake amount, slash amount, and region size.
guardian-registry.trust: Shows service economics and coverage rules are public PDA data.

guardian-region.title: GuardianRegion
guardian-region.body: Registered realtime region endpoint and proof state.
guardian-region.visible: Region bounds, owner, operator, endpoint, TLS flag, stake, penalties, and proof counters.
guardian-region.trust: Players can verify who serves a region and whether liveness proofs are being submitted.

backpack.title: Backpack
backpack.body: Player-owned inventory PDA for block resources, material slots, and item references.
backpack.visible: Owner, backpack ID, capacity, item count, placement, update slots, and safe sample slots.
backpack.trust: Inventory is inspectable from public account data instead of only from the game UI.

recipe-table.title: RecipeTable
recipe-table.body: Authority-owned smelting recipe table used by the smelting program.
recipe-table.visible: Authority, recipe count, update slot, heat tiers, input counts, output counts, and recipe IDs.
recipe-table.trust: Players can inspect which recipes exist before spending backpack resources.

market-listing.title: MarketplaceListing
market-listing.body: Public marketplace listing state for a backpack slot.
market-listing.visible: Seller, listing ID, currency, source index, full source slot, price, buyer, and final state.
market-listing.trust: Market escrow and settlement can be audited without trusting a private order book.

forged-items.title: Forged item records
forged-items.body: A convenience scan that finds forged outputs inside live Backpack accounts.
forged-items.visible: Source account type, owner, backpack identity, forged sample slots, item code, and item ID.
forged-items.trust: Shows forged results through real account data while staying honest that a dedicated forging PDA family is not yet live.

civilization-rule-book.title: Civilization RuleBook
civilization-rule-book.visible: Author, hashes, target program/PDA, threshold, risk level, tally counters, and status.
civilization-rule-book.trust: Players can inspect proposal targets and power thresholds before rules affect gameplay.

civilization-rule-signature.title: Civilization signatures
civilization-rule-signature.body: One citizen signature record for a rule.
civilization-rule-signature.visible: Signer, side, snapshot hash, snapshot power, and signed time.
civilization-rule-signature.trust: Signature power comes from settled Civilization Value, not self-reported numbers.

civilization-rule-tally.title: Civilization tallies
civilization-rule-tally.visible: Agree, reject, abstain, challenge power, required power, and threshold result.
civilization-rule-tally.trust: Lets players inspect whether a rule really met the threshold.

civilization-execution-receipt.title: Civilization execution receipts
civilization-execution-receipt.body: Account recording rule execution or acknowledgement.
civilization-execution-receipt.visible: RuleBook, executor, executed slot, and timestamp.
civilization-execution-receipt.trust: Binds execution evidence to the accepted rule.

civilization-power-snapshot.title: Civilization Value snapshots
civilization-power-snapshot.visible: Authority, snapshot hash, total active power, window, and expiry.
civilization-power-snapshot.trust: Players can inspect total available power and expiry for a voting window.

civilization-citizen-power.title: CitizenPower accounts
civilization-citizen-power.body: One citizen power amount inside a snapshot window.
civilization-citizen-power.visible: Citizen, snapshot, power, settled slot, and expiry.
civilization-citizen-power.trust: Proves an individual signer power comes from a settled account.

transparency.title: Players can audit the world from contract code to public PDA state.
transparency.body: NiceChunk treats public state as part of the game interface. Players should be able to inspect who exists, which backpacks and listings exist, what recipes are active, which regions serve realtime play, and which rules or accounts are still only planned.

cards.title: Players are public account records, not hidden rows in a private database.
cards.body: PlayerProfile and PlayerSession PDAs expose the wallet, position, equipped backpack pointer, session authority, and limits that the client is allowed to use.

cards.title: Backpacks and market listings are readable storage objects.
cards.body: Backpack and MarketplaceListing accounts show item counts, owners, states, prices, and safe sample slots so players can audit inventory movement.
points: Forged items surface through Backpack item slots.

cards.title: Terrain and mining state are tied to verifiable world config.
cards.body: GlobalConfig fixes the world seed and config hashes, while ChunkBrokenState and ResourceDropTable expose what has been mined and which extra-drop rules exist.
points: World seed and hashes are public.
Broken-block records are compact but readable.
Drop tables are bounded PDA data.

cards.title: Governance must be inspectable before it becomes powerful.
cards.body: The Civilization contract defines rulebooks, signatures, tallies, receipts, and Civilization Value accounts, but live player submission still waits for devnet proof.
points: Runtime config and gated contracts are separated.
Rule targets must point to inspectable PDAs.

map.audit: Read PlayerProfile accounts to see wallets, positions, equipment slots, and equipped backpack pointers.
Read Backpack accounts to inspect owners, capacity, item counts, block resources, and item/material slots.
Read forged records from Backpack item slots without inventing a separate live forging program.
Read RecipeTable accounts to inspect active recipe tables, heat tiers, input counts, output counts, and update slots.
Read BuildSite, BuildingManifest, and BuildingShard accounts to inspect foundation footprints, upload progress, active revisions, and NCM3 payload metadata.
Read GuardianRegion and GuardianRegistry accounts to audit realtime region owners, endpoints, stake, proof counts, and penalties.
Read MarketplaceListing accounts to inspect seller, buyer, price, currency, escrowed slot, state, and settlement slots.
Read RuleBook, signature, tally, receipt, power snapshot, and citizen power accounts to inspect the governance path.

runtime.title: What the game client is actually configured to use now.
runtime.body: This section reads the public mainnet.json runtime index and separates active game configuration from contracts that exist in code but are still gated.

config.label: Runtime index
config.title: The game still uses the public runtime config.
config.body: mainnet.json reports cluster {cluster} and app version {version}. It remains the high-frequency game config, not a website i18n bundle.

programs.label: Active programs
programs.title: Programs currently referenced by the game client.
programs.body: These IDs are the authoritative program IDs the current browser client receives from mainnet.json.

alias.label: Shared game program
alias.title: Some modules currently point to the same program ID.
alias.body: This reflects the current game state: chunk, backpack, smelting, and market are wired to the shared game program until split deployments are activated.

civilization.label: Civilization
civilization.title: Civilization contract exists, but live submission remains gated.
civilization.bodyConfigured: The Civilization program is present in the runtime configuration.
civilization.bodyGated: The Civilization program is documented and decodable here, but it is not in the current mainnet.json runtime config yet.

logic.title: Understand the contracts as a connected trust graph.
logic.body: Each map shows the actor, program boundary, PDA evidence, and public verification surface. The goal is to explain what the contracts actually protect before a reader opens the code or RPC browser.

diagrams.title: Wallet intent becomes public state only through narrow program gates.
diagrams.body: The client can prepare instructions, but durable game state appears only after the wallet, session authority, and program checks agree on the same GlobalConfig and owner relationship.

nodes.label: Player wallet
nodes.detail: Owns profile creation, session refresh, backpack actions, and market settlement intent.

nodes.label: Session authority
nodes.detail: Short-lived key allowed to repeat selected gameplay actions without prompting the wallet every block.

nodes.label: Genesis Core
nodes.detail: Fixes the world seed, hashes, NCK mint, build bounds, and shared program assumptions.

nodes.label: Player Program
nodes.detail: Validates owner/profile/session relationships before gameplay instructions can rely on identity.

nodes.label: GlobalConfig
nodes.detail: The immutable runtime anchor read by the client and every dependent program.

nodes.label: PlayerProfile
nodes.detail: Public profile record with owner, position, equipment slots, backpack pointer, and forge progress.

nodes.label: PlayerSession
nodes.detail: Action budget and expiry record binding the wallet to a session authority.

nodes.label: Game client
nodes.detail: Reads mainnet.json, derives PDAs, and submits only the instructions the visible state allows.

nodes.label: PDA browser
nodes.detail: Reads program accounts from devnet RPC and decodes known account layouts in this page.

diagrams.title: Generated terrain, broken blocks, and rewards are separate audit surfaces.
diagrams.body: Chunk state does not store the whole world. It stores compact deltas against deterministic terrain plus bounded rule tables for resource and surface decoration behavior.

nodes.label: Mine block intent
nodes.detail: A wallet or session authority declares the world coordinate and expected generated block.

nodes.label: Foundation intent
nodes.detail: The player claims a bounded footprint that later protects occupied chunks from incompatible writes.

nodes.label: Chunk verifier
nodes.detail: Recomputes generated block identity from GlobalConfig before accepting a broken-block write.

nodes.label: Chunk authority PDA
nodes.detail: Lets related programs coordinate chunk occupancy without giving them unrestricted write access.

nodes.label: ChunkBrokenState
nodes.detail: Stores compact 3-byte records for blocks that differ from generated terrain.

nodes.label: FoundationChunk
nodes.detail: Indexes which player foundations occupy each chunk so building and mining can reason about conflicts.

nodes.label: ResourceDropTable
nodes.detail: Publishes extra-drop rules without embedding mutable probabilities in client-only code.

nodes.label: SurfaceDecorationTable
nodes.detail: Keeps surface decoration sync auditable against deterministic terrain faces.

diagrams.title: A player building is a staged, hashed payload before Guardians publish it.
diagrams.body: The Building program separates footprint ownership, upload progress, final manifest hash, chunk registration, and Guardian blueprint publication so each risk has a specific PDA witness.

nodes.label: Player session
nodes.detail: Build actions require the player profile and a valid session before site or manifest state changes.

nodes.label: NCM3 payload
nodes.detail: The client shards a building payload, commits the expected hash, and uploads bounded segments.

nodes.label: Building Program
nodes.detail: Owns BuildSite v2, upload shards, manifest finalization, resize state, and legacy migration.

nodes.label: Blueprint authority
nodes.detail: A restricted program-derived signer publishes verified blueprint summaries into Guardian regions.

nodes.label: BuildSite
nodes.detail: Stores owner, footprint, active/pending revisions, staged resize dimensions, and chunk counts.

nodes.label: BuildingManifest
nodes.detail: Stores expected hash, NCM dimensions, rotation, offsets, shard bitmap, and active/uploading status.

nodes.label: BuildingShard
nodes.detail: Stores one bounded piece of the upload so finalization can reconstruct and verify the payload hash.

nodes.label: Chunk occupancy index
nodes.detail: Building registration updates chunk occupancy through the chunk authority boundary.

nodes.label: GuardianRegion blueprint
nodes.detail: Guardian regions store blueprint hash, revision, and record count for realtime serving.

diagrams.title: Backpack slots move through smelting and market custody without becoming invisible.
diagrams.body: The inventory layer uses full slot snapshots and authority PDAs so manufacturing and market settlement can mutate backpack contents while preserving an inspectable trail.

nodes.label: Backpack owner
nodes.detail: Starts backpack creation, item use, smelting selection, listing, cancellation, or purchase delivery.

nodes.label: Buyer / seller
nodes.detail: Market settlement binds payment, seller, buyer, price, currency, and escrowed slot state.

nodes.label: Backpack Program
nodes.detail: Owns slot creation, removal, and authorized delivery from other programs.

nodes.label: Smelting Program
nodes.detail: Reads recipe tables, consumes selected resources/fuels, and appends material outputs.

nodes.label: Market Program
nodes.detail: Escrows a selected backpack slot and releases it on cancel or settlement.

nodes.label: Backpack
nodes.detail: Stores block resources, material slots, forged item refs, durability, grade, and item identity.

nodes.label: RecipeTable
nodes.detail: Stores heat, inputs, outputs, disabled flags, and per-output volume for recipes.

nodes.label: MarketplaceListing
nodes.detail: Stores seller, buyer, state, price, currency, and the full escrowed backpack slot.

nodes.label: Forged item view
nodes.detail: The PDA browser derives forged outputs from Backpack item slots instead of pretending a separate live forging program exists.

nodes.label: Treasury fee route
nodes.detail: Market settlement routes configured fees while preserving buyer delivery and seller proceeds in account state.

diagrams.title: Rule changes need signatures, tallies, receipts, and power snapshots before execution.
diagrams.body: Civilization is intentionally split into proposal evidence, signature evidence, tally evidence, execution receipts, and value snapshots so governance can be audited before it controls live game surfaces.

nodes.label: Rule author
nodes.detail: Publishes a rulebook with target program, target PDA, payload hash, and required power.

nodes.label: Citizen signer
nodes.detail: Signs yes/no against the exact rulebook and settled power snapshot.

nodes.label: Civilization Program
nodes.detail: Publishes rulebooks, signatures, tallies, receipts, power snapshots, and citizen power records.

nodes.label: Target adapter authority
nodes.detail: Binds approved rule execution to the target program instead of giving rule authors direct write access.

nodes.label: RuleBook
nodes.detail: Canonical proposal record with target, payload hash, expiry, and required power threshold.

nodes.label: RuleSignature
nodes.detail: One signer-side record that binds vote side and power to the exact rulebook.

nodes.label: RuleTally / Receipt
nodes.detail: Aggregates power and records whether a finalized rule was executed.

nodes.label: PowerSnapshot
nodes.detail: Authority-settled total active power used to validate impossible signature sets.

nodes.label: CitizenPower
nodes.detail: Per-citizen power record with expiry so old influence cannot silently remain valid.

evidence: Live runtime remains gated until configured
